reason: Most of my orders come from regular buyers who just call me, and I quote them from memory in ten seconds. I don't get enough new enquiries to need a machine drafting quotes, and IndiaMART already gives me a catalogue and leads.
objection: Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month, plus GST, is real money for a 3-4 person firm, and it fixes a problem I barely have. My rates change daily and depend on who the customer is, so I don't trust a bot to get the price right.
would_change_my_mind: If a trader like me, in my line, showed me the desk had brought them new paying customers from enquiries they used to miss, and the full price was closer to Rs 25,000 with no monthly fee.
